ModMetaData.name: Organ Trauma - Manipulation Penalties
ModMetaData.author: BaconEggCheese
ModMetaData.description:
Damage to internal organs (Brain, Heart, Liver, Kidney, Stomach, Lung) now inflicts a Manipulation penalty, scaled by how badly hurt the organ is (Minor/Moderate/Severe/Critical) and which tier the organ belongs to. Penalties from multiple damaged organs stack.
Tier 1 (Brain): -10% / -20% / -40% / -80% Tier 2 (Heart, Liver): -5% / -10% / -20% / -40% Tier 3 (Kidney, Stomach, Lung): -2% / -5% / -10% / -20%
Works on existing saves - applies to pawns already in your game, not just new ones.
